name: Lachish
overview: Lachish was a significant fortified city in biblical history, often involved in military conflicts. It was one of the five Amorite cities whose kings united to besiege Gibeon, opposing Israel (Joshua 10:5). Joshua led Israel to capture Lachish, with the LORD delivering the city into their hands after a fierce battle (Joshua 10:31-32). Later, Lachish was part of the territory allotted to Judah (Joshua 15:39) and faced threats from powerful enemies such as Sennacherib, king of Assyria, who besieged it during King Hezekiah's reign, prompting Hezekiah to seek peace through tribute (2 Kings 18:13-14). These events highlight God's sovereignty in the rise and fall of cities according to His purposes.
